The group risk management function is primarily accountable for setting the
group’s risk management framework and policy, providing oversight and
independent reporting to the Board of Management and to the Board of Directors
through the Board Risk Committee.
The Risk Management Department ensures implementation of the Group’s
risks management framework and policy in the business units and provide an
independent overview of the effectiveness of risk management by the first line of
defense.

Provides an independent assessment of the adequacy and effectiveness of the
overall risk management framework and risk governance structures and reports to
the Board through the group Board Audit Committee.
